overview: A hiring and orientation management app for a retail store's roadie crew, with rosters, paperwork, training groups, leader cards and an Opening Questions review section.
features: Per-question Opening Questions ownership so the Managing Partner can approve Dan questions
Accept and Decline stay available on pending suggestions after the 48 hours
Final questions are locked until the Managing Partner reopens them
Expired manager access no longer counts as question ownership
Opening Questions is restricted to the six allowed roles in the backend
Demo mode no longer grants a role to people without access
Only a Managing Partner can change the Managing Partner role
Managing Partner has the same access as Admin for gift bags, sign-ups, uniforms and crews
The card pop-up keeps the browser's back button working
